observed_failure.error: ControllerTickError: authoritative source readback has 4 unresolved dead-letter entrie(s) in selected connector scope
observed_failure.cause: four dead letters from session 2026-11-24 refused by the retired 99% chain rule (#7839 moved it to 0.90) stay pending; a bounded refresh (reconcile_and_pull) failed on every unresolved entry in its scope, the steady pull only on new ones

change.bounded_refresh_gate: run_controller_tick uses the pre/post unresolved count rule for bounded refresh and steady pull. Both pre-tick subtraction and terminal scoped admission now share _trusted_dlq_connector_counts: global totals must agree, each bucket must belong to a configured connector, all five statuses must be nonnegative integers (bool rejected), and every per-status sum must equal its global total. An invalid pre-tick map uses the strict terminal rule; it is never parsed or subtracted.
change.backlog_report: accepted readback (loop success payload) and the top level of the tick result printed by the bounded refresh carry pre_existing_unresolved_dlq_backlog = {count, by_connector: {connector_id: {unresolved_count, oldest_rejected_at, oldest_age_seconds}}} for the selected connectors; steady-pull keys pre_existing_unresolved_dlq_by_connector/count are kept and now also emitted for bounded refresh
change.source_readback: services/source_ingestion/runtime.py: controller readback adds dlq_oldest_unresolved_at_by_connector (oldest rejected_at of pending/replay_failed/schema_rejected entries per connector), computed in the existing single pass over DLQ entries; absent in an older image, the age is reported as null
change.steady_pull: unchanged: same pre/post rule and keys; its 4 existing gate tests pass unchanged
change.artifact_contract_note: Human/Ops added services/source_ingestion/runtime.py to the canonical artifacts contract at 2026-11-27T11:58:33Z; it supplies the per-connector oldest rejection timestamp required by acceptance 1.

operator_resolution.path: POST /api/source-ingest/dlq/replay with {entry_ids: [the four 2026-11-24 entry ids], reason: <why the cause is fixed>, actor_id: <operator>}
operator_resolution.what_happens: the existing replay processor re-runs each entry through pipeline.replay_source_event: these entries carry no frontier_id, so the configured margin connector runs again under the live 0.90 chain rule (and the #7839 gap bridge); the provider serves the latest published session, so success stores that later session, which supersedes 2026-11-24. Each entry gets status replayed, replay_attempts+1, audit_action_ref, and one foundation.dlq.replay.applied audit action with the operator reason is appended to source_ingest_audit.jsonl. A replay that still fails sets replay_failed and leaves the entry unresolved.
operator_resolution.nothing_deleted: the DLQ journal is append-only (replace_entry appends the new status); no entry is removed. The deploy script's --force recovery covers only egress-denied entries and does not touch these.
operator_resolution.no_new_writer: no new status, endpoint or writer; superseding is the outcome of the replay run, not a separate mark
